# Withstand Damage

> Datasworn `move.oracle_rollable:starforged/suffer/withstand_damage.withstand_damage` · 1d100

- [10] Immediate catastrophic destruction. All aboard must Endure Harm or Face Death, as appropriate.
- [15] Destruction is imminent and unavoidable. If you do not have the means or intention to get clear, Endure Harm or Face Death as appropriate.
- [15] Destruction is imminent, but can be averted if you Repair your vehicle and raise its integrity above 0. If you fail, see 11-25.
- [15] You cannot Repair this vehicle until you Resupply and obtain a crucial replacement part. If you roll this result again prior to that, see 11-25.
- [15] The vehicle is crippled or out of your control. To get it back in action, you must Repair and raise its integrity above 0.
- [15] It's a rough ride. All aboard must make the Endure Harm, Endure Stress, or Companion Takes a Hit move, suffering a serious (-2) cost.
- [10] You’ve lost fuel, energy, or cargo. Sacrifice Resources (-2).
- [5] Against all odds, the vehicle holds together.
